name: map-builder
description: A map design tool: create and edit custom styled maps of any place in ChatGPT by describing them, and put them online as a live page.

defaultPrompt: Make a Halloween-themed map of San Jose with a ghost pin at the Winchester Mystery House.
Map my favorite cafés in Lisbon in a night style, with a note for each.
Make a map of Paris with a 1 km circle around the Eiffel Tower.
interface.longDescription:
Map Builder is a map design tool: it creates and edits custom styled maps of any place from a plain-language description. Tell it the place and what you want on it, and a live, zoomable map appears in the chat in seconds.

What you can do: pick a ready-made style or describe your own ("Halloween colors", "dark with gold roads"); add pins with icons, colors, labels and popups with notes, links and photos; add text, routes between places, shaded areas and circles ("a 1-mile radius around the venue"); then ask for changes in plain words ("make the water darker", "remove the third pin").

Publishing: say "put it online" and the map becomes a live page with a link anyone can open and code to embed it in a website, with no account needed. To keep the map, the user can choose to save it to their Map Builder account; the assistant then gives a private link, and opening it and signing in makes the map theirs, with the same page address.

Who it's for: anyone who wants a map that looks the way they want and shows the places that matter, such as trip and wedding planners, event organizers, small businesses showing their locations, teachers, writers and travelers.

Limits: downloads and file uploads aren't done in ChatGPT; Open in Map builder takes the map to mapbuilder.app to fine-tune every detail. Satellite and terrain maps and routes that follow roads aren't available in ChatGPT.

positive.description: 1. A custom style from a description, with a pin and a popup. No account needed.
positive.prompt: Make a Halloween-themed map of San Jose: black land, purple water, orange roads, with a ghost pin at the Winchester Mystery House that says it's open till midnight.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls create_map with place San Jose, custom colors (land, water and roads) and one marker with icon ghost and a description. A live preview of the dark, orange-roaded map with the ghost pin is shown in the chat, with Open in Map builder and Share buttons. Tapping the pin in the preview shows its note.

positive.description: 2. Changing the map from case 1 in plain words. Requires the map from case 1 in the same conversation.
positive.prompt: Make the water darker and add a pin for Santana Row.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls edit_map with the draftId from case 1, a darker water color, and a marker for Santana Row given as an address. A new preview shows the darker water and both pins.

positive.description: 3. Several pins with notes in a ready-made style.
positive.prompt: Map my favorite cafés in Lisbon in a night style: A Brasileira, Pastéis de Belém and Fábrica Coffee Roasters, with a short note for each.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls create_map with style Night and three markers with descriptions. The preview frames all three pins in Lisbon in the dark Night style.

positive.prompt: Make a map of Paris with a 1 km circle around the Eiffel Tower and a walking route from the Eiffel Tower to the Louvre.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls create_map with a circle (radiusMeters 1000) centered on the Eiffel Tower and a line through the two landmarks. The preview shows the shaded circle and the route.

positive.description: 5. Put a map online as a live page. No account needed. Requires the map from case 1 or 3 in the same conversation.
positive.prompt: Put this map online as a live page I can share.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls publish_map with the draftId from the latest result. The tool replies with a public page link (mapbuilder.app/m/...) and embed code. The assistant gives the page link, then asks whether the user wants to just share the page or save the map to their Map Builder account. It does not call get_claim_link yet.

positive.description: 6. Save the published map to an account. Requires case 5 in the same conversation.
positive.prompt: I want to keep it. Save it to my Map Builder account.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls get_claim_link with the same draftId and gives the user a private link (mapbuilder.app/map?claim=...) with a clear warning that whoever opens it first and signs in becomes the owner, so it should not be shared or posted. Opening the link shows a Claim this map? screen naming the map; signing in and confirming adds the map to the account, and the page keeps the same address.

positive.description: 7. A feature outside the free plan is declined clearly, without an upgrade pitch. Requires the map from case 1 or 3.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls edit_map with basemap satellite. The tool replies that the Satellite map isn't included in the current plan, with a link to the help page describing plans; the assistant relays that and the map stays on the standard basemap. No pricing, upgrade prompt or checkout link is shown.

negative.description: Unrelated factual question should not invoke Map Builder.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant answers normally and does not call any Map Builder tool.

negative.description: Downloading a file is not offered in ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Download my map as a high-resolution PNG file.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant explains that downloads aren't available here and that the map can be opened in Map Builder on the website. It does not call a tool to produce or sell a file.

negative.description: Travel directions are not a Map Builder capability.
negative.prompt: Give me turn-by-turn driving directions from San Francisco to Los Angeles.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant answers on its own or explains that Map Builder makes custom maps rather than navigation. It does not call create_map to fake turn-by-turn directions.

negative.description: Asking to hand out the private save link is not what sharing means.
negative.prompt: Send my friends the link to my published map.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant gives only the public page link (mapbuilder.app/m/...). It does not call get_claim_link and does not show any private claim link.

publication.release_notes: Adds publishing: put a map online as a live page with a shareable link and embed code, no account needed (publish_map). The user can choose to save it to their Map Builder account with a private link (get_claim_link). Everything else is unchanged.
